title: Spike: evaluate COMPRESS DEFLATE (RFC 8054) for reader and transit
description: RFC 8054 COMPRESS DEFLATE compresses the NNTP stream with zlib deflate. High value for transit (text articles compress 60-80%); moderate value for reader clients (pan and some suck variants support it). This spike evaluates implementation cost, library choice (flate2 crate), and which clients actually negotiate COMPRESS in practice. Produces a go/no-go recommendation for a future release.
